post.summary:
IAMResourceCallback handles IAM resource callback requests.
This is a unified endpoint that dispatches requests to different handlers
based on the resource type and method specified in the request body.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
IAMResourceCallbackReq describes the IAM resource callback request.
This is the standard request format defined by BlueKing IAM.

post.summary:
IAMV4ResourceCallback queries resources for IAM V4 using Basic Auth.
The username is bk_iam and the password is the IAM V4 system token.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
IAMV4ResourceCallbackReq describes the existing IAM V4 HTTP callback
contract. The HTTP handler retains strict JSON validation for method-specific
fields.

protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

v3IAMResourceCallbackPage.description: IAMResourceCallbackPage describes the pagination for IAM resource callback.

type.title: type is the resource type, e.g., "host", "plugin", "business"

method.title:
method is the callback method, e.g., "list_instance", "fetch_instance_info"
Supported methods:
  - list_attr: List resource attributes
  - list_attr_value: List attribute values
  - list_instance: List resource instances
  - fetch_instance_info: Fetch instance details
  - list_instance_by_policy: List instances by policy expression
  - search_instance: Search instances by keyword
  - fetch_instance_list: Fetch instance list by IDs
  - fetch_resource_type_schema: Fetch resource type schema

filter.title: filter contains the query conditions, structure varies by method

v3IAMResourceCallbackReq.description:
IAMResourceCallbackReq describes the IAM resource callback request.
This is the standard request format defined by BlueKing IAM.

code.title: code is the response code, 0 means success

data.title: data is the response data, structure varies by method

v3IAMResourceCallbackResp.description:
IAMResourceCallbackResp describes the IAM resource callback response.
This is the standard response format defined by BlueKing IAM.

code.description: code is INVALID_ARGUMENT, UNAUTHENTICATED, NOT_FOUND, or INTERNAL.

v3IAMV4ResourceCallbackError.description: IAMV4ResourceCallbackError describes a non-200 IAM V4 callback error.

v3IAMV4ResourceCallbackPage.description: IAMV4ResourceCallbackPage describes one-based IAM V4 pagination.

type.description: type is biz, networkarea, networkunit, package_type, or package.

filter.description:
filter contains optional parent/keyword for list_instance, or required ids
(at most 1000 nonempty strings; an empty array is allowed) for
fetch_instance_info.

requires.description:
requires selects fetch_instance_info attributes; omitted or empty means
all.

v3IAMV4ResourceCallbackReq.description:
IAMV4ResourceCallbackReq describes the existing IAM V4 HTTP callback
contract. The HTTP handler retains strict JSON validation for method-specific
fields.

data.description:
data is {count, results} for list_instance, or an array of instance objects
for fetch_instance_info.

v3IAMV4ResourceCallbackResp.description:
IAMV4ResourceCallbackResp documents the IAM V4 HTTP response envelope.
Success contains only data; failure contains only error, with a non-200
status.
